units.id: mission:Turn in Tarquin|description|695|0
units.english: Deliver captain Tarquin to law enforcement on the nearest planet.
units.italian: Consegna il capitano Tarquin alle forze dell'ordine sul pianeta più vicino.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|You board the <origin> and look around its derelict hull, which appears to be in fairly stable condition. You could risk repairing it for a greater profit, or you could salvage what you can from the ship and leave the rest.|723|0

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	With the repairs finished you head to the cockpit to see if the <origin> starts without exploding. Prepared to bolt for the airlock should things go wrong, you start the ship.|774|0

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	The ship thrums to life. With bated breath you wait for the sound of some system exploding, but nothing happens. Success! The ship is yours.|777|0
units.english: The ship thrums to life. With bated breath you wait for the sound of some system exploding, but nothing happens. Success! The ship is yours.
units.italian: La nave vibra e prende vita. Con il fiato sospeso aspetti il suono di qualche sistema che esplode, ma non succede nulla. Successo! La nave è tua.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	As you are fixing the engine systems a valve bursts open. Luckily the secondary valve is mechanical and doesn't need power, allowing it to close itself automatically and prevent the coolant from forcefully spraying out. units.english: As you are fixing the engine systems a valve bursts open. Luckily the secondary valve is mechanical and doesn't need power, allowing it to close itself automatically and prevent the coolant from forcefully spraying out. With more caution, you finish up your repairs of the engines.
units.italian: Mentre ripari i sistemi dei motori, una valvola si apre di colpo. Per fortuna la valvola secondaria è meccanica e non ha bisogno di corrente, così si chiude da sola e impedisce al refrigerante di schizzare fuori con violenza. Con più cautela, concludi le riparazioni dei motori.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	With a few simple repairs you manage to get the ship's power systems operational. Briefly. The power shuts down again with a violent vibration shuddering through the ship. You quickly run back to your ship before the <origin> breaks apart.|839|0
units.english: With a few simple repairs you manage to get the ship's power systems operational. Briefly. The power shuts down again with a violent vibration shuddering through the ship. You quickly run back to your ship before the <origin> breaks apart.
units.italian: Con qualche riparazione semplice riesci a rimettere in funzione i sistemi di alimentazione della nave. Per poco. L'alimentazione si spegne di nuovo mentre una vibrazione violenta scuote la nave. Torni di corsa sulla tua nave prima che la <origin> si sfaldi.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	As you are patching up a segment of hull you notice that a deformation in it is slowly expanding. To make matters worse, this is a structurally essential part of the hull. You quickly run back to your ship before the <origin> breaks apart.|842|0
units.english: As you are patching up a segment of hull you notice that a deformation in it is slowly expanding. To make matters worse, this is a structurally essential part of the hull. You quickly run back to your ship before the <origin> breaks apart.
units.italian: Mentre rattoppi un segmento di scafo noti che una deformazione si sta allargando lentamente. Peggio ancora, è una parte strutturalmente essenziale dello scafo. Torni di corsa sulla tua nave prima che la <origin> si sfaldi.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	As you are fixing the engine systems a valve bursts open. With no power the secondary valve cannot close itself off, letting coolant uncontrollably fly into the hull. The force of the liquid sends a violent vibration shuddering through the ship. You quickly run back to your ship before the <origin> breaks apart.|845|0
units.english: As you are fixing the engine systems a valve bursts open. With no power the secondary valve cannot close itself off, letting coolant uncontrollably fly into the hull. The force of the liquid sends a violent vibration shuddering through the ship. You quickly run back to your ship before the <origin> breaks apart.
units.italian: Mentre ripari i sistemi dei motori, una valvola si apre di colpo. Senza alimentazione la valvola secondaria non può chiudersi, e il refrigerante vola incontrollato dentro lo scafo. La forza del liquido provoca una vibrazione violenta che scuote la nave. Torni di corsa sulla tua nave prima che la <origin> si sfaldi.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	Wary of your own foolish repairs you decide to leave the ship alone. However, you did manage to hang onto a little bit of scrap worth <payment> you found during your repairs.|850|0
units.english: Wary of your own foolish repairs you decide to leave the ship alone. However, you did manage to hang onto a little bit of scrap worth <payment> you found during your repairs.
units.italian: Diffidente delle tue stesse riparazioni avventate, decidi di lasciare stare la nave. Però sei riuscito a tenerti un po' di rottame trovato durante i lavori, del valore di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	Your fears seem to be warranted as the <origin> begins to falls apart the moment you detach.|851|0
units.english: Your fears seem to be warranted as the <origin> begins to falls apart the moment you detach.
units.italian: I tuoi timori sembrano fondati: la <origin> comincia a sfaldarsi nel momento in cui ti sganci.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	As it begins to thrum to life, a loud explosion rocks the ship!|854|0
units.english: As it begins to thrum to life, a loud explosion rocks the ship!
units.italian: Appena la nave comincia a vibrare e prendere vita, una forte esplosione la scuote!

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	(Run.)|856|0
units.english: (Run.)
units.italian: (Corri.)

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	You start running through the tight corridors of the ship. Objects are tumbling everywhere, and more explosions threaten to sweep you off your feet.|857|0
units.english: You start running through the tight corridors of the ship. Objects are tumbling everywhere, and more explosions threaten to sweep you off your feet.
units.italian: Cominci a correre nei corridoi stretti della nave. Oggetti rotolano ovunque, e altre esplosioni minacciano di farti cadere.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	(Run into the airlock.)|859|0
units.english: (Run into the airlock.)
units.italian: (Corri nel portello.)

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	(Dive for the airlock.)|861|0
units.english: (Dive for the airlock.)
units.italian: (Tuffati nel portello.)

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	(Slide into the airlock.)|863|0
units.english: (Slide into the airlock.)
units.italian: (Scivola nel portello.)

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	As you slide across the floor, explosions erupt on both sides of you, and you're sure that you look like an action hero as you careen through the airlock to safety. Having narrowly escaped death and not wishing to chance it, you quickly depart.|864|0
units.english: As you slide across the floor, explosions erupt on both sides of you, and you're sure that you look like an action hero as you careen through the airlock to safety. Having narrowly escaped death and not wishing to chance it, you quickly depart.
units.italian: Mentre scivoli sul pavimento, esplosioni erompono ai tuoi due lati, e sei sicuro di sembrare un eroe d'azione mentre attraversi il portello a tutta velocità verso la salvezza. Scampato per un soffio alla morte e senza voglia di tentare la sorte, te ne vai in fretta.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	As you run towards the airlock, explosions erupt on both sides of you, and you're sure that you look like an action hero as you barge through the airlock to safety. Having narrowly escaped death and not wishing to chance it, you quickly depart.|867|0
units.english: As you run towards the airlock, explosions erupt on both sides of you, and you're sure that you look like an action hero as you barge through the airlock to safety. Having narrowly escaped death and not wishing to chance it, you quickly depart.
units.italian: Mentre corri verso il portello, esplosioni erompono ai tuoi due lati, e sei sicuro di sembrare un eroe d'azione mentre ti apri un varco attraverso il portello verso la salvezza. Scampato per un soffio alla morte e senza voglia di tentare la sorte, te ne vai in fretta.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	As you dive towards the airlock, explosions erupt on both sides of you, and you're sure that you look like an action hero as you tuck and roll through the airlock to safety. Having narrowly escaped death and not wishing to chance it, you quickly depart.|870|0
units.english: As you dive towards the airlock, explosions erupt on both sides of you, and you're sure that you look like an action hero as you tuck and roll through the airlock to safety. Having narrowly escaped death and not wishing to chance it, you quickly depart.
units.italian: Mentre ti tuffi verso il portello, esplosioni erompono ai tuoi due lati, e sei sicuro di sembrare un eroe d'azione mentre ti raccogli e rotoli attraverso il portello verso la salvezza. Scampato per un soffio alla morte e senza voglia di tentare la sorte, te ne vai in fretta.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	Despite your best efforts to make the ship actually fly, it just won't. On the upside, now you have time to loot and pilfer some outfits from the ship as you please. Before leaving the cockpit you find a credit chip sitting on the controls worth <payment>.|880|0
units.english: Despite your best efforts to make the ship actually fly, it just won't. On the upside, now you have time to loot and pilfer some outfits from the ship as you please. Before leaving the cockpit you find a credit chip sitting on the controls worth <payment>.
units.italian: Nonostante tutti i tuoi sforzi per far volare davvero la nave, non ne vuole sapere. In compenso ora hai il tempo di saccheggiare e portarti via qualche modulo dalla nave a piacere. Prima di lasciare la cabina di pilotaggio trovi un gettone di credito appoggiato sui comandi, del valore di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	However, you notice a blinking light on the controls of the ship. You wonder what it could signal as you approach it, and once you get close enough you realize that it warns of the arrival of "hostile spacecraft" entering the system. The derelict must have been a pirate trap, and to make matters worse, the ship appears to be rigged to blow! You now have a pretty good guess at what you're dealing with as you race back to your ship.|883|0
units.english: However, you notice a blinking light on the controls of the ship. You wonder what it could signal as you approach it, and once you get close enough you realize that it warns of the arrival of "hostile spacecraft" entering the system. The derelict must have been a pirate trap, and to make matters worse, the ship appears to be rigged to blow! You now have a pretty good guess at what you're dealing with as you race back to your ship.
units.italian: Però noti una luce lampeggiante sui comandi della nave. Ti chiedi cosa possa segnalare mentre ti avvicini, e quando sei abbastanza vicino capisci che avverte dell'arrivo di "astronavi ostili" nel sistema. Il relitto doveva essere una trappola dei pirati, e a peggiorare le cose la nave sembra preparata a esplodere! Ora hai un buon sospetto di cosa stai affrontando mentre corri di nuovo verso la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	However, moments later a screen lights up in the cockpit displaying something strange. Upon closer inspection you realize it's some form of malicious software, and it's attempting to hack into your ship!|888|0
units.english: However, moments later a screen lights up in the cockpit displaying something strange. Upon closer inspection you realize it's some form of malicious software, and it's attempting to hack into your ship!
units.italian: Però, poco dopo, uno schermo si illumina nella cabina di pilotaggio mostrando qualcosa di strano. Guardando più da vicino capisci che è una forma di software malevolo, e sta cercando di introdursi nel sistema della tua nave!

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	You race back to your ship, quickly launching and destroying the <origin>, but by the time you manage to destroy the virus it has already hacked into your bank account; your account reports a change in balance of <payment>.|889|0
units.english: You race back to your ship, quickly launching and destroying the <origin>, but by the time you manage to destroy the virus it has already hacked into your bank account; your account reports a change in balance of <payment>.
units.italian: Corri di nuovo alla tua nave, decolli in fretta e distruggi la <origin>, ma quando riesci a eliminare il virus ha già fatto irruzione nel tuo conto bancario; il conto riporta una variazione di saldo di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	Deciding not to risk it you quickly scour the ship for valuable scrap and outfits.|892|0
units.english: Deciding not to risk it you quickly scour the ship for valuable scrap and outfits.
units.italian: Deciso a non rischiare, setacci in fretta la nave in cerca di rottame e moduli di valore.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	Upon a brief inspection of the ship you find few valuables, only managing to salvage a meager <payment> from the <origin>.|897|0
units.english: Upon a brief inspection of the ship you find few valuables, only managing to salvage a meager <payment> from the <origin>.
units.italian: Dopo una breve ispezione della nave trovi pochi oggetti di valore, e riesci a recuperare solo una misera somma di <payment> dalla <origin>.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	Searching through the ship you find that it is quite valuable; you manage to salvage a substantial amount from the <origin>, worth <payment>.|910|0
units.english: Searching through the ship you find that it is quite valuable; you manage to salvage a substantial amount from the <origin>, worth <payment>.
units.italian: Cercando per la nave scopri che vale parecchio: riesci a recuperare dalla <origin> una somma sostanziosa, del valore di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	Hidden away under a panel you find a small box. Opening it reveals it is filled with <payment>.|919|0
units.english: Hidden away under a panel you find a small box. Opening it reveals it is filled with <payment>.
units.italian: Nascosta sotto un pannello trovi una piccola scatola. Aprendola scopri che è piena di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	As you search the ship for anything valuable you find a large black case filled with 325,000 credits. Investigating further you find a text log next to the case, and you decide to take both of them with you.|929|0
units.english: As you search the ship for anything valuable you find a large black case filled with 325,000 credits. Investigating further you find a text log next to the case, and you decide to take both of them with you.
units.italian: Mentre cerchi qualcosa di valore per la nave trovi una grande custodia nera piena di 325.000 crediti. Frugando ancora trovi accanto alla custodia un registro di testo, e decidi di portarti via entrambi.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	As you search the ship for anything valuable you find some kind of map tucked into a panel. It's easy to carry, allowing you time to further salvage a meager <payment> from the <origin>.|935|0
units.english: As you search the ship for anything valuable you find some kind of map tucked into a panel. It's easy to carry, allowing you time to further salvage a meager <payment> from the <origin>.
units.italian: Mentre cerchi qualcosa di valore per la nave trovi una specie di mappa infilata in un pannello. È facile da portare, e ti lascia il tempo di recuperare ancora una misera somma di <payment> dalla <origin>.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	(Detonate the ship and leave so that others can't loot it.)|939|0
units.english: (Detonate the ship and leave so that others can't loot it.)
units.italian: (Fai esplodere la nave e vattene, così nessun altro potrà saccheggiarla.)

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	(Try and find a bit more salvage.)|940|0
units.english: (Try and find a bit more salvage.)
units.italian: (Prova a recuperare ancora un po' di materiale.)

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	Before you depart you detonate the ship to prevent any other derelict hunters from scouring the now empty ship.|942|0
units.english: Before you depart you detonate the ship to prevent any other derelict hunters from scouring the now empty ship.
units.italian: Prima di partire fai esplodere la nave, per impedire ad altri cacciatori di relitti di setacciare la nave ormai vuota.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	You attempt to search the ship for more valuables and luckily find some extra salvage worth <payment>. However, the hull begins to creak and groan, prompting a hasty return to your ship.|949|0
units.english: You attempt to search the ship for more valuables and luckily find some extra salvage worth <payment>. However, the hull begins to creak and groan, prompting a hasty return to your ship.
units.italian: Provi a cercare altri oggetti di valore e per fortuna trovi materiale in più, del valore di <payment>. Però lo scafo comincia a scricchiolare e gemere, e ti costringe a tornare in fretta sulla nave.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	Not a moment too soon, as the <origin> begins to violently fall apart the moment your ship detaches.|950|0
units.english: Not a moment too soon, as the <origin> begins to violently fall apart the moment your ship detaches.
units.italian: Appena in tempo: la <origin> comincia a sfaldarsi con violenza nel momento in cui la tua nave si sgancia.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	You attempt to search the ship for more valuables but to no avail. However, the hull begins to creak and groan, prompting a hasty return to your ship.|955|0
units.english: You attempt to search the ship for more valuables but to no avail. However, the hull begins to creak and groan, prompting a hasty return to your ship.
units.italian: Provi a cercare altri oggetti di valore ma senza successo. Però lo scafo comincia a scricchiolare e gemere, e ti costringe a tornare in fretta sulla nave.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	Not a moment too soon, as the <origin> begins to violently fall apart the moment your ship detaches.|956|0
units.english: Not a moment too soon, as the <origin> begins to violently fall apart the moment your ship detaches.
units.italian: Appena in tempo: la <origin> comincia a sfaldarsi con violenza nel momento in cui la tua nave si sgancia.

units.id: mission:Boarding Derelict|	You make your way to the cockpit in the hopes of finding any valuables. Initially finding nothing, you turn to leave and search more of the ship.|959|0
units.english: You make your way to the cockpit in the hopes of finding any valuables. Initially finding nothing, you turn to leave and search more of the ship.
units.italian: Ti dirigi alla cabina di pilotaggio sperando di trovare qualcosa di valore. Non trovando nulla all'inizio, ti volti per uscire e cercare in altre parti della nave.
